text:
Don't hold the spoon in your left hand.
Don't put your elbows on the table.
Fold your napkin neatly.
That's how to begin.

Extract the square root of three thousand three hundred thirteen.
Where is Tanganyika? In what year was Cervantes born?
I'll give you a zero for conduct if you speak to your classmate.
That's how to go on.

Do you think it proper for an engineer to write verse?
Culture is an ornament; business is business.
If you keep seeing that girl, we'll close our doors to you.
That's how to live.

Don't be so crazy. Be polite. Be proper.
Don't drink. Don't smoke. Don't cough. Don't breathe.
Ah yes, don't breathe! Say no to every no.
And rest: die.
